title: All-available entry at 5% participation (half the fillable cap)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), seed 1. Sensitivity of the lead book to its participation assumption; nothing adopted.
why: cs_aro_all3k (114.17 seed 1, 113.83 seed 2) stakes up to 10% of the entry candle's quote volume, and so does every book: median participation is 10% for cs_aro too (68% of its entries are capped). A post-hoc flat-slippage re-score keeps the ranking up to 0.77%/side, but a size-dependent impact model hits every book at 10%. Early 036 depth (2 days, informal, not the gated cost_model fit) prices cap-sized orders at ~2.5 bps/side median (mean 5.4, p90 16), close to half the spread. This arm asks how much of the lead survives at half the participation.
arm: cs_aro_all3k_p5 = NNNC_CS_ARO_ALL3K with QUOTE_VOLUME_HEADROOM_MULT 20 (fillable cap = candle quote volume / 20, and confirm_trade_entry's gate at 20x the order); MIN_QUOTE_VOLUME unchanged; seed 1 weights (the multiple is MODEL_KEY_IGNORED); cs_aro's thresholds copied unchanged
instrument: all 15 fold records; >= 80% of stakes on trades shared with cs_aro equal min(3000 x w, quote volume / 20) within 1%; median stake ratio p5 / all3k on shared trades < 1 (the halved cap bit); 0 position adds; agree share within 0.05 of cs_aro's. Fail -> INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read
